messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — P0: Service /v1/generate elevated error rate (>90%) across us-west-2 cluster, latency spike. Automatic retry rate high. Triggered by 2279000122. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/serve/p0
irene: acked, oncall here. I'm seeing a mix of CUDA errors and container restarts. Starting triage.
ajay: on it, pulling logs. Is this cross-rack only?
sam: seeing pod restart loops for serve-replica-2 on node ibx-node-17. kube events show OOMKilled then CrashLoopBackOff.
irene: logs snippet:``` 
E runtime: cudaMemcpyAsync failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T16:02:12Z serve: kvcache restore failed: inconsistent mapping, dropping cache
panic: oom during allocator growth
``` 
ajay: look at NIC stats — lots of retransmits on ibx-node-17/18. If RDMA packets are being dropped we can get weird GPU OOMs due to stalled KV cache updates and fanout causing memory spikes.
netops: confirmed switch counters high on ToR-ibx-5: ECN and retransmit spikes starting ~16:00 UTC. We see a flapping link on port 12 (peer fanout). Opening ticket to FW team, will attempt port reset.
devon: mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic away from us-west-2 primary fabric to fallback region (us-west-2b) via routing policy; 2) switch affected node pool to degraded mode (disable cross-node KV cache) to avoid large cache restores; 3) roll affected pods onto fresh nodes.
irene: executing step 2 now: updating config to disable inter-node KV caching and lowering batch target size to reduce memory pressure. Command:``` 
kubectl -n serve set env deploy/serve-runtime KV_CACHE_ENABLED=false
kubectl -n serve set env deploy/serve-runtime MAX_BATCH_TOKENS=512
``` 
sam: re-scheduled offending pods with node taint/evict to force new placements:``` 
kubectl cordon ibx-node-17 && kubectl drain ibx-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --force
``` 
ajay: rolling restart triggered. Monitoring metrics: error rate falling but latency still elevated.
kristin: customer-impact note — CS reported 3 customers in us-west-2 seeing 502s. Logged on status page, sending brief.
netops: performed port reset on ToR-ibx-5 port 12 at 16:07 UTC. Observed partial restoration but ECN counters still elevated. We're scheduling a short maintenance window to replace SFP in 10m.
irene: observed a drop in retransmits after pod restarts, but one node still shows sporadic CUDA context errors. Attaching recent runtime excerpt:``` 
W runtime: context lost on gpu0, recovering state
E runtime: cudaDriverTimeout detected, resetting context
E kubelet: container runtime restarted container serve-replica-2 (exitCode=137)
``` 
devon: while netops continues hardware work, I recommend enabling cross-region fallback for the next 30m and enabling a model degradationsafe route that uses the quantized-small variant on unaffected nodes. Patching route now.
ajay: applied route change — 12% of traffic shifted to fallback region, 88% still in primary. Setting automatic fallback threshold to 25% errors.
sam: confirmed rollout to quantized model for hot-path via console. This should drop memory footprint and avoid further OOMs.
kristin: posting incident update for customers: "We are investigating increased errors in us-west-2. Traffic is being routed to fallback and engineers are mitigating. No data loss."
irene: monitoring for 15m windows. If errors remain below 5% we'll start reintroducing capacity.
netops: SFP swapped at 16:25 UTC, link stabilized, ECN counters trending down. Good signal.
ajay: probes show p99 latency still ~450ms (baseline 120ms). Working with runtime team to tune batching and preemption.
devon: temporary config applied to cap max concurrent tokens per request and to force preemptible scheduling:``` 
kubectl -n serve set env deploy/serve-runtime TOKEN_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT=6
``` 
irene: after configuration changes and node rotations, error rate down to 2.4% at 16:33 UTC, p50/p95 improved. Marking initial mitigation success.
sam: uncordoning ibx-node-17 after validated stability.
netops: will monitor ToR for 1hr. If flaps reoccur we'll plan deeper fabric maintenance.
kristin: CS update posted + customers notified of mitigation.
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Reduced error rate below threshold, auto-escalation suppressed. Pager resolved? (awaiting oncall confirmation)
irene: closing pager for now. We'll keep this thread open for postmortem notes. Assigning action items: netops to run switch diagnostics and replace spare SFP inventory (netops). Runtime to add guardrail to avoid KV cache restores after packet-loss-induced corruption (ajay/devon). Follow-up postmortem scheduled 2026-03-16 18:00 UTC.
ajay: quick note — implement conservative KV cache recovery: validate checksum before applying restore, otherwise fallback to empty cache.
devon: will raise PR with change and add regression test simulating partial packet loss.
irene: thanks all. Good job on swift mitigation. :thumbsup:
